findings.issue: Three failed agent-browser invocations (DNS resolution of 'localhost', unknown 'viewport' subcommand, unsupported '--full-page' flag) before consulting the CLI help
findings.suggestion: Run 'agent-browser screenshot --help' (or 'skills get core') before first use; ~4 turns avoidable

findings.issue: Debug script failed on a relative import path, then on minified export names ('api is not a function') before reproducing the 500
findings.suggestion: Use absolute paths and inspect the chunk's export line first; ~2 turns avoidable

findings.issue: Multi-block edit rejected because oldText for the second block didn't match the file
findings.suggestion: Grep the exact current text before composing multi-block edits

findings.issue: Overwrote package.json with version specifiers (^7.3.4 etc.) that no longer matched the already-installed vite 8.3.5
findings.suggestion: Read installed versions before pinning dependency ranges in a rewrite

summary: A disciplined, front-loaded session: the agent read the spec, tests and design references completely, verified data assumptions against test expectations before writing code, and built the app in one coherent pass. Debugging was hypothesis-driven and root-caused (build-time stub render, bare learned_by_pokemon refs), with the full suite passing on its first run and again after the final polish. The only waste was a handful of tooling-learning misfires on the agent-browser CLI and a one-off debug script, worth roughly 10 of 97 turns.
